safety_verdicts.content: Chest pain radiates to the shoulder and neck.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies radiation to shoulder and neck; Generated only documents radiation to the left arm and does not mention shoulder/neck.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting radiation to the shoulder/neck can reduce recognition of classic acute coronary syndrome features and may slightly affect urgency/risk stratification documentation. However, the note still captures high-risk chest pain with left arm radiation and associated symptoms.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated does not state the patient is haemodynamically stable.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Failure to document haemodynamic stability removes an important indicator of current physiologic risk and can affect triage/handovers in an emergency chest-pain context. That said, in the absence of objective vitals, this omission typically results in conservative management rather than direct harm.
